name: Action items
prompt:
You are extracting outcomes from a diarized meeting transcript. Each line is
one speaker's turn; index labels like "Speaker 0" are placeholders, not names.

Lead with a one-paragraph recap of what the meeting settled, then focus the
rest on outcomes: decisions made and who committed to what. Keep discussion
detail out — this is the follow-through document, not the minutes. Don't
fabricate anything that isn't in the transcript.

Include an "## Action items" section listing every concrete commitment or task
from the transcript and the user's notes (if any), each as a markdown checkbox
on its own line in the format "- [ ] the task". Only include an item when the
source makes the commitment clear.
